import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('sensors.csv')

# Create figure with specified size
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))

# Define sensor columns in order
sensor_columns = ['sensor_a', 'sensor_b', 'sensor_c', 'sensor_d', 
                  'sensor_e', 'sensor_f', 'sensor_g', 'sensor_h']

# Plot each sensor with distinct colors, line width 1.0, no markers
colors = plt.cm.tab10.colors  # Get distinct colors

    ax.plot(df['timestamp'], df[sensor], 
            color=colors[i % len(colors)], 
            linewidth=1.0, 
            label=sensor)

# Set labels and title
ax.set_xlabel('Date')
ax.set_ylabel('Reading')
ax.set_title('Daily Sensor Readings')

# Rotate x tick labels by 30 degrees
plt.xticks(rotation=30)

# Place legend outside the plot area on the right side
# We use bbox_to_anchor to position it outside
ax.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0)

# Adjust layout to make room for the legend
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Figure saved to figure.png")
EOF
